# Audit

Use this skill for canonical audits and recovery analysis.

- Reconstruct state from current code, canonical contracts, accepted implementation, tests, and live provider state.
- Distinguish observed facts, contract gaps, stale metadata, and speculative findings.
- Audit work is read-only unless mutation is explicitly requested.
- Do not turn findings into new requirements or implementation work.
- When Inari is available, obtain the current audit procedure with `inari skill <scenario>`.
- Do not duplicate or guess Inari command semantics in this file.
